generationMethod: Extracted the pristine v1.2.0 src/promptGenerator.ts blob directly via `git show HEAD:src/promptGenerator.ts` (HEAD was 983a476... and untouched at extraction time) into a temporary same-directory module so its relative imports (./run, ./types, ./workflows, ./correctionRouter, ./greenfield/...) resolved against the unchanged v1.2.0 sources. Rendered every mode/stage prompt with the same fixed synthetic RunMetadata used for tests/fixtures/v120-baseline/prompt-hashes.json, then extracted normalized structural fields. The temporary module was deleted after generation and is not part of the repository.
normalization: All dynamic fields (runId, projectRoot, runFolder, source/target repo) were held constant via a fixed synthetic RunMetadata, so no additional text substitution was required.
